_description.metadata: Parameters used to generate this dataset.
_description.runs[].table: Feature matrix for the alternatives (f1 x f2).
_description.runs[].true_ranks: Ground truth ranks of the alternatives (0 is best).
_description.runs[].true_utilities: Ground truth utility values for each alternative.
_description.runs[].weights: Weights used in the utility function.
_description.runs[].subranks: Sequence of elicited subranks. 'items' is indices ordered best to worst. 'cards' is blank cards between consecutive items.
